title: Fall Creek Farm & Nursery
summary: Industry-body profile of Fall Creek describing its nursery footprint across multiple countries, employee scale and variety portfolio breadth.
why_it_matters: A third-party industry body restating operational scale gives partial corroboration of company-authored scale claims, though association profiles are usually member-supplied.

reading.rationale: Useful corroboration but adds little beyond the company's own materials.

commercial_position.rationale: Footprint breadth is a competitive factor in genetics supply.
